title: Descriptor Sync Must Not Recompute Selection Exit
description: Fix secondary selection showing stale/wrong ids: sync_descriptor must not recompute selection_exit_highlight from descriptor selected flags (lags wasm); clear exit when descriptor forces selection set change.
summary: sync_descriptor no longer calls set_selection_exit_last_transition when descriptor selected flags diverge from wasm selection; that recomputed exit chrome from potentially stale JSX round-trips and could show ids from an older selection. When the descriptor forces a different selection set, selection_exit_highlight is cleared instead; user-visible exit chrome stays owned by select/setSelection/delete paths only.
